Pricing.title: Simple plans that grow with your catalogue.
Pricing.footnote: Prices in USD. Taxes are calculated at checkout by Paddle. Cancel at any time.

Faq.q8: Can I cancel at any time?
Faq.a1: No. Proficios uses the official Google Play Developer API through a service account that you create in your own Play Console. There's no waiting list and no app verification.

Dashboard.inboxZeroBody: Every review for {app} has a reply. Lovely work.
